rationale: Class 2 row-level X02 flag reports an internal row_key with missing interest_rate/basis_spread, but the bundle does not expose the flagged row's issuer, investment text, fair value, or maturity. Raw SOI tables 4-6 and comparative SOI tables 10-13 were checked: actual debt instrument rows disclose coupon/rate terms in the Investment cell, while subtotal/equity/cash rows may lack interest_rate but are not enough to identify row_key 237372. Because the raw source does not decide which field/row is wrong, the issue cannot be grounded as real_error or false_alarm.
